notes_for_editor: Built year, builder, purpose and staffing are not in any source found, so none is stated. The 1950 description is a survey-station write-up; no source says the tower was used to watch for fires, so confirm its role before listing it as a fire lookout. Nothing describes its condition or access after 1950. The record's coordinates (27.16671, -97.6904) agree with the NGS NAD 83(1993) position on the datasheet (27 10 00.45562 N, 097 41 25.80480 W, about 27.16679, -97.69050) to within about 15 m; they were not changed. A forum thread and a topo listing about the Risken property were seen in search but not used. The record's kind 'tower' matches the NGS marker type.
